original_bad_head_error: Dependent role lacks a unique same-analysis inherited case

corrections.previous_assumption: Every tawkeed owner must appear in the event main argument list.
corrections.why_too_narrow: The same accepted event can explicitly preserve a PP object in a prepositional qualifier while preserving its semantic emphasis in another qualifier. This does not promote that object to actor or direct object.
new_required_chain: Exact accepted claim is present in the same licensed ASSERT analysis and has its proof.
Direct prepositional and tawkeed qualifiers belong to that same claim.
The preposition_object relation, activated genitive assignment, object reference and tawkeed head use the same nominal reading and span.
The owner and emphatic return reference are resolved in the supplied source scope and context.
The PP attachment reaches the actual predicate verb and matches the source preposition and unchanged semantic_relation.

corrections.previous_assumption: The governor must equal the full occurrence span, even when gold explicitly allows its licensed stem.
new_required_chain: The head has its own active assignment and reading within this analysis.
Its segmentation is licensed and actual head span equals its exact stem span.
The declared gold span_basis is occurrence_or_licensed_stem and the stem is inside that occurrence.

unchanged_guards: original gold files and all denominators
limitations: Structural report validation here has no optional external SourceAudit instance; the full original-suite evaluation performs that source-byte audit separately.
This tool revision fixes a checker correspondence, not a new runtime interpretation or new blinded experiment.
The explicit PP-owner path extends only tawkeed; it does not authorize all arbitrary qualifier owners.
